title: Cabbage and Crunchy Salad with Indian Twist
description: A refreshing salad with crunch and flavor from Indian spices.

ingredients.name: herbed
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup, chopped fresh herbs (such as cilantro or parsley)

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded cabbage and chopped crunchy snack.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chopped fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Pour the herb mixture over the cabbage mixture and toss to combine.
Add the mixed greens to the bowl and toss again to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
